installCommand: set -euxo pipefail; echo "=== versions ==="; node -v; corepack --version || true; corepack enable; corepack prepare pnpm@8.15.0 --activate; corepack pnpm -v; echo "=== install ==="; corepack pnpm install
buildCommand: SCHEMA=packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma; [ -f "$SCHEMA" ] || SCHEMA=../../packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma; npx prisma@^5.10.0 generate --schema="$SCHEMA" && turbo run build --filter=web
